items.title: F5 patches critical BIG-IP APM zero-day (CVE-2026-94127) under active exploitation
items.summary: F5 released a patch for a heap-based buffer overflow (CVSS v4.0 9.3) in BIG-IP APM configured as an OAuth Authorization Server, which threat actors are actively exploiting for remote code execution. CISA added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a Friday deadline for federal agencies.

items.title: Check Point ships emergency hotfix for actively exploited CVE-2026-93616 flaw
items.summary: Check Point released the R82.20 Security Hotfix for a critical path traversal flaw (CVSS 9.8) in its Security Management Server that lets unauthenticated attackers upload and execute scripts, and confirmed a handful of customers have already been attacked. IOCs are published for teams hunting for compromise.

items.title: FBI confirms 'cybersecurity incident' after ShinyHunters claims FBIJobs.gov breach
items.summary: The FBI confirmed it is investigating a reported compromise of its FBIJobs.gov recruitment portal after ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen sensitive personnel data. Samples reviewed by media reportedly included names, addresses, SSNs, and emergency-contact details, though the full scope is not yet confirmed.

items.title: Gyazo confirms unauthorized access exposed 23.6 million user records
items.summary: Gyazo disclosed that on September 11 a third party exploited a vulnerability in its image-upload infrastructure, gaining unauthorized access to its database and exposing email addresses, password hashes, session info, and metadata for hundreds of millions of images. Separately, researchers detailed TASKSTOMP, a Windows backdoor abusing legitimate tools like Task Scheduler and PowerShell to steal documents, Wi-Fi passwords, and clipboard contents.

items.title: Storm ransomware reportedly hits Applied Composites, U.S. aerospace and defense supplier
items.summary: The Storm ransomware operation allegedly targeted Applied Composites, a manufacturer of advanced composite components for aerospace, defense, and space programs, raising concerns about disruption to engineering and production workflows. The claim remains unverified by the company or independent investigators.
